name: Kesari Diamond Drops
description: Statement diamond-cut fabric earrings in mustard and burgundy, finished with a woven geometric band and a green-and-gold bead drop. Cut, backed, and balanced by hand so they sit light on the lobe — considered enough for evening, easy enough for morning chai.
shortDescription: Bigger mustard geometric drops with gold bead dangles
careInstructions: Store in the provided cotton pouch. Avoid perfume directly on fabric. Spot clean only.
comfort: Lightweight cotton construction with a firm backing — comfortable for all-day wear.
packaging: Arrives wrapped in tissue, nestled in a reusable cotton pouch.

process.title: Pattern & cut
process.description: The diamond silhouette is cut from mustard cotton and a burgundy geometric textile, then matched as a pair.

process.title: Backing & form
process.description: Each piece is stiffened and backed so the shape holds without weighing the ear.

process.title: Bead finishing
process.description: A green bead and textured gold drop are attached and weighed for a quiet, even sway.

name: Cocoa Crescent Drops
description: Semi-circular fabric earrings in deep cocoa, banded with a white geometric weave and framed in a whisper of gold. A slender silver charm hangs from the straight edge — quiet movement for dinners, festivals, and the in-between hours.
shortDescription: Bigger cocoa D-shape drops with a silver charm
careInstructions: Store flat in the cotton pouch. Keep away from moisture and perfume.
comfort: Firm yet light crescent form with a soft reverse — sits close without pinching.
packaging: Arrives wrapped in tissue, nestled in a reusable cotton pouch.

process.title: Pattern & cut
process.description: Crescents are cut from cocoa cotton and aligned with a geometric textile band.

process.title: Border finishing
process.description: A fine gold-tone edge frames the weave so the geometry reads cleanly from across a table.

process.title: Charm setting
process.description: A ribbed silver charm is set at the centre so each pair moves as one.

name: Vanam Textile Studs
description: Small circular studs in forest-green textile, set with a dark geometric weave and a gold beaded rim. Compact, polished, and light enough to forget — until someone asks where they are from.
shortDescription: Smaller forest-green geometric studs with a gold rim
careInstructions: Wipe the rim gently. Store in the cotton pouch. Spot clean fabric only.
comfort: Low-profile posts with a soft backing — made for all-day wear.
packaging: Arrives wrapped in tissue, nestled in a reusable cotton pouch.

process.title: Pattern & cut
process.description: Circles are cut from forest-green textile so the geometric field sits at the centre of each stud.

process.title: Rim setting
process.description: A gold-tone beaded rim is set by hand to hold the textile taut and catch the light.

process.title: Post finishing
process.description: Posts and soft backs are fitted and checked as a pair for even weight.

name: Raga Heart Studs
description: Heart-shaped fabric studs in deep burgundy, centred with a white geometric weave. Small, warm, and precise — a daily pair that still feels like a gift.
shortDescription: Smaller burgundy heart studs with a geometric centre
careInstructions: Store in the cotton pouch. Avoid perfume on fabric. Spot clean only.
comfort: Soft-backed hearts that sit close to the ear — unobtrusive from morning to night.
packaging: Arrives wrapped in tissue, nestled in a reusable cotton pouch.

process.title: Pattern & cut
process.description: Hearts are cut in pairs from burgundy cotton so the geometric centre aligns on both.

process.title: Centre setting
process.description: The woven motif is placed and secured so the geometry reads clearly at conversational distance.

process.title: Post finishing
process.description: Posts are fitted, backs softened, and each pair checked for a matched silhouette.
